verdict.rationale: Galileo's Python SDK, MCP server, and docs show that key workflows (logging traces/spans, creating experiments, managing datasets, custom metrics) can be done programmatically, not just via the console UI (galileo-docs-2/4/6/8/32). However, there's no evidence of a documented public REST/OpenAPI spec (galileo-probe-3 shows all OpenAPI paths 404), and console-only features like alert setup (galileo-docs-9/14) and review queues (galileo-docs-40) are not shown to have API equivalents, so full UI/API parity is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: a discoverable full API/OpenAPI reference, and API-level parity evidence for alerting and human-review queue configuration.
